text:
```yaml
name: CI - ARM64

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        ruby-version: [3.0]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Set up Ruby ${{ matrix.ruby-version }}
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby-version }}
        bundler-cache: true
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
        
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        bundle exec rspec python/spec/dependabot/python/pipenv_dependency_grapher_spec.rb
        
    - name: Run RuboCop
      run: |
        bundle exec rubocop python/lib/dependabot/python/pipenv_dependency_grapher.rb
        
    - name: Run static analysis
      run: |
        bundle exec rake analyze
```
